_comment: Build configuration for the public website.
Set the service's root directory to `frontend`. That makes this directory the
build context, so Railway finds frontend/Dockerfile at the root of it with no
builder setting to configure, and reads this file rather than the repository
root's railway.json (which builds the backend image).
No build-time variables. Every data page is force-dynamic, so the image builds
without a reachable backend, and API_BASE_URL is read at runtime — server-side
only, never exposed to the browser.
